                  Command Guardrails & Destructive Shield
                
                
Critical destructive commands are protected with explicit confirmation to prevent accidental data loss.

              

            


            
            

              
              

                

                  

                    

                      
                    

                    

                      

                        FLUSHALL
                        BLOCKED
                      

                      Requires --force-destructive flag
Example: FLUSHALL --force-destructive
                    

                  

                  
                

                

                  
🛡️ Real In-Engine Protection

                  
Standard FLUSHALL commands sent via RESP TCP are automatically intercepted before reaching worker sharding ring buffers.

                  
                  

                

              


              
              

                

                  

                    

                      
                    

                    

                      

                        FLUSHDB
                        BLOCKED
                      

                      Explicit confirmation required
Example: FLUSHDB --force-destructive
                    

                  

                  
                

                

                  
🛡️ Keyspace Guard Active

                  
Requires explicit confirmation flag. Prevents accidental deletion of current keyspace partition.

                  
                  

                

              


              
              

                

                  

                    

                      
                    

                    

                      

                        SHUTDOWN
                        BLOCKED
                      

                      Engine runtime protected
Example: SHUTDOWN --force-destructive
                    

                  

                  
                

                

                  
🛡️ Runtime Process Guardian

                  
Blocks process termination without destructive override to prevent accidental engine crashes in production.

                  
                  

                

              


              
              

                

                  

                    

                      
                    

                    

                      

                        CONFIG
                        READ-ONLY
                      

                      Admin role required (read-only access)
Write operations are restricted
                    

                  

                  
                

                

                  
🛡️ Read-Only Guardrail

                  
CONFIG SET modifications require explicit engine administrator confirmation flag. Read operations (CONFIG GET) remain unrestricted.
